name: Grandmother’s Hunger
body:
Ancient teeth are no obstacle to the hag’s hunger.

Prerequisite(s): Grandmother’s Teeth, Vital Strike, base attack bonus +6, hag’s claws class ability.

Benefit(s): When you use your bite to attempt a single attack with the attack action, treat that attack as though you have the grab and swallow whole monster special abilities. You may use this attack to swallow creatures of up to one size category smaller than your own size. The ongoing damage to the swallowed creatures is equal to your base bite damage.
